tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List standard PaperDock projects accessible to the connected account, including its current role and effective MCP capabilities for each. Use projectId only for subsequent tool calls and do not show it unless explicitly requested.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new PaperDock project with a starter main.tex only when the user explicitly asks. Names are unique per owner, ignoring letter case and leading/trailing spaces. On PROJECT_NAME_ALREADY_EXISTS, do not retry create_project with the same name or a case/whitespace-only variant. Call list_project

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List project file metadata without loading full file contents.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Find where a word, phrase, citation key, label, LaTeX command, or other text appears across editable project files when its file or location is unknown. Search is case-insensitive and returns matching paths, positions, revisions, and short snippets. If the target file is already known, use read_file

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read an editable project file or return a 10-minute signed download URL for a private project asset. Provide exactly one target: fileId or path. tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Get the latest successful compiled PDF for an explicit entry .tex path, with a signed download link valid for at most 10 minutes, size, generation time, and freshness information. tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Create one new editable text file from UTF-8 content. For compatibility contentBase64 is accepted only for UTF-8 text at an editable extension. Existing paths are never overwritten; use edit_file for existing text. Binary uploads and replacements are not supported by MCP: ask the user to upload or r

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create a new editable text file at a new project path from supplied content. Pass an explicit empty string to create an empty file. Existing paths are never overwritten.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Immediately edit one existing editable text file and record the applied change in PaperDock's Review changes UI. tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List active project comments and their replies. Resolved comment history is not returned by this tool.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Create an open Comment on a .tex project file and post it immediately to project collaborators without changing the source file. Later deletion cannot undo prior delivery or reading. Selection offsets may be inferred from quote. Provide exactly one target: fileId or path.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a reply under the connected PaperDock account, marked as created via an AI agent, immediately to an open Comment. tools.name: list_chat_messages
tools.description: Read recent project chat messages in chronological order.

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Post a message under the connected PaperDock account, marked as created via an AI agent, immediately to the selected private PaperDock project's Chat. It is visible to project members, and later editing or deletion cannot undo prior delivery or reading.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_projects" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List standard PaperDock projects accessible to the connected account, including its current role and effective MCP capabilities for each. Use projectId only for…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "list_projects" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: List standard PaperDock projects accessible to the connected account, including its current role and effective MCP capabilities for each. Use projectId only for…

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_project" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "read_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_file, edit_file, list_comments, create_comment, reply_to_comment, list_chat_messages · Private data: list_files, search_files, read_file, upload_file, create_file, edit_file, create_comment, send_chat_message · Public sink: upload_file, create_comment, reply_to_comment, send_chat_message · Destructive: create_project, edit_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_file, edit_file, list_comments, create_comment, reply_to_comment, list_chat_messages · Private data: list_files, search_files, read_file, upload_file, create_file, edit_file, create_comment, send_chat_message · Public sink: upload_file, create_comment, reply_to_comment, send_chat_message · Destructive: create_project, edit_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
